news.summary: Acquisition rumors sent Marvell tumbling hard in a single week, but the real question for long-term investors is whether the chaos around a potential Lumentum deal hides a rare buying opportunity or a costly distraction from Marvell's AI roadmap.

news.title: Lumentum Is Up 11% in a Week. Will Marvell Pay “Close to $100 Billion”?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum rose 11% in a week on an optics rebound and a Bloomberg report that Marvell Technology is in advanced talks to buy it. A deal reportedly paid in Marvell stock would tie any premium to Marvell’s share price.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 一週漲幅達 11%。Marvell 會支付「接近 $100 Billion」的價格嗎？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Lumentum 因光學產業反彈及彭博報導 Marvell Technology 正進行進階收購洽談，一週內上漲 11%。據報導若以 Marvell 股票支付交易，任何溢價將與 Marvell 股價掛鉤。

news.title: Piper Sandler’s $400 Target Says Marvell’s Selloff Went Too Far
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell stock is down 41% from its June high after reports that it’s in advanced talks to buy Lumentum, reportedly in an all-stock deal. Piper Sandler kept its Overweight rating and $400 target, 104% above the current price, and pointed to Lumentum’s lasers as key to faster, lower-power AI networks.
news.title_zh: Piper Sandler 的 $400 目標價表明 Marvell 的拋售過度
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Marvell 股價自六月高點下跌 41%，此前有報導稱其正就收購 Lumentum 進行深度會談，據悉為全股票交易。Piper Sandler 維持其「增持」評級及 $400 目標價，較現價高出 104%，並指出 Lumentum 的雷射為更快速、低功耗 AI 網路的關鍵。

news.title: Marvell Sinks 14% in a Week on Lumentum Talks: Chipmakers Like It “Don’t Have a Choice”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology fell 14% in the past week on reported Lumentum talks, then in a chip selloff after Intel’s weak outlook. Lumentum’s lasers would make Marvell a bigger Broadcom rival and give Coherent a competitor backed by Marvell’s chips.
news.title_zh: Marvell 因 Lumentum 談判一週內下跌 14%：像它這樣的晶片製造商「別無選擇」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Marvell Technology 過去一週因傳出 Lumentum 談判而下跌 14%，隨後因 Intel 悲觀展望引發晶片拋售。Lumentum 的雷射將使 Marvell 成為更大的 Broadcom 競爭對手，並給 Coherent 一個由 Marvell 晶片支持的競爭對手。
